info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Liquidity Risk Models Retrieval API provides access to specific liquidity risk models based on a given parameter. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions and analysts looking to retrieve detailed model information for risk assessment and regulatory compliance purposes. By using the provided identifier, consumers can obtain crucial data regarding liquidity risk management strategies. This API supports use cases in financial modeling, risk evaluation, and reporting.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific liquidity risk model by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific liquidity risk model identified by its unique ID. Use this to access model attributes, parameters, and other relevant data.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the details of the liquidity risk model identified by RES-100045. This provides the necessary information for the server to process the request and return the appropriate response.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the liquidity risk model details.

backtestWindowMonths.description: The number of months used in the backtesting window.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses bearer authentication, which requires a JSON Web Token (JWT) to be included in the request header. Clients must obtain a JWT through a login process and include it in the 'Authorization' header as 'Bearer <token>'.
